sections.heading: 1. Wall hinge first
lines: ① Stand a foot from a wall, facing away.
② Push your hips back to touch the wall.
③ 5 reps, then a kettlebell deadlift.
④ Pick a bell you control for 10 crisp reps.

caption:
Kettlebell swings leaving Lulu's lower back sore? Check whether you're hinging or squatting.

A swing is a hip hinge. Hips go back, knees soften slightly, and the power comes from snapping the hips forward. Squatting the bell or lifting it with your arms often shifts the work to places that don't enjoy it.

Practise a wall hinge and a kettlebell deadlift first, pick a weight you can control for ten clean reps, and keep sets short.

Back pain spreading into the leg or pins and needles are worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios are happy to look at your technique. Book online via the link in bio
